arxiv-2104-03921.title: A matrix with sums of Catalan numbers—LU-decomposition and determinant
arxiv-2104-03921.creator: Helmut Prodinger
arxiv-2104-03921.description:
A 2021 arXiv research paper by Helmut Prodinger. Following Benjamin et al., a matrix with entries being sums of two neighbouring Catalan numbers is considered. Its LU-decomposition is given, by guessing the results and later prove it by computer algebra, with lots of human help. Specializing a parameter, the determinant turns out to be a Fibonacci number with odd index, confirming earlier results, obtained back then by combinatorial methods. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification
05A15, 11B39, 15B36

1. Introduction

Let
\mathscr{C}_{n}=\frac{1}{n+1}\binom{2n}{n}
be the
n
-th Catalan number.

arxiv-2107-09788.title: Highly Linear Nonmagnetic Circulator Enabled By A Temporal Nonreciprocal Phase Shifter
arxiv-2107-09788.creator: Sajjad Taravati, George V. Eleftheriades
arxiv-2107-09788.description: Abstract Conventional circulators are made of magnetic ferrites and suffer from a cumbersome architecture, incompatibility with integrated circuit technology and inability for high frequency applications. To overcome these limitations, here we propose a lightweight low-profile non-magnetic circulator comprising a nonreciprocal time-varying phase shifter. This circulator is composing a nonreciprocal temporal phase shifter and two reciprocal delay-line-based phase shifters.

arxiv-2207-02636.title: Gradient-Free Kernel Stein Discrepancy
arxiv-2207-02636.creator: Matthew A. Fisher, Chris. J Oates
arxiv-2207-02636.description: Abstract Stein discrepancies have emerged as a powerful statistical tool, being applied to fundamental statistical problems including parameter inference, goodness-of-fit testing, and sampling. The canonical Stein discrepancies require the derivatives of a statistical model to be computed, and in return provide theoretical guarantees of convergence detection and control.

arxiv-2307-10076.title: DFT+ μ \mu : Density Functional Theory for Muon Site Determination
arxiv-2307-10076.creator: S. J. Blundell, T. Lancaster
arxiv-2307-10076.description: Abstract The technique of muon spin rotation ( μ \mu SR) has emerged in the last few decades as one of the most powerful methods of obtaining local magnetic information. To make the technique fully quantitative, it is necessary to have an accurate estimate of where inside the crystal structure the muon implants.

pmc-10607557.title: The Effects of Heparan Sulfate Infusion on Endothelial and Organ Injury in a Rat Pneumosepsis Model
pmc-10607557.creator: Daan P. van den Brink, Derek J. B. Kleinveld, Annabel Bongers, Jaël Vos, Joris J. T. H. Roelofs, Nina C. Weber, Jaap D. van Buul, Nicole P. Juffermans
pmc-10607557.description: Septic shock is characterized by endothelial dysfunction, leading to tissue edema and organ failure. Heparan sulfate (HS) is essential for vascular barrier integrity, possibly via albumin as a carrier. We hypothesized that supplementing fluid resuscitation with HS would improve endothelial barrier function, thereby reducing organ edema and injury in a rat pneumosepsis model.

pmc-11344154.title: Prevalence of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease in Pakistan: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11344154.creator: Fazal Hassan, Maria Farman, Kauser Aftab Khan, Muhammad Awais, Sohail Akhtar
pmc-11344154.description: Nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is the most common chronic liver condition globally and the leading cause of liver-related death and morbidity. The goal of this study was to collect current data in order to calculate the pooled prevalence of NAFLD in Pakistan.

pmc-12618652.title: Evaluation of progesterone receptors with different cutoff values according to menopausal status in hormone-positive early breast cancer
pmc-12618652.creator: Ayumi Ogawa, Takeshi Murata, Masayuki Yoshida, Natsuko Ohgi, Hiromi Hashiguchi, Ayako Nakashoji, Hinako Maeda, Chikashi Watase, Eriko Iwamoto, Shin Takayama
pmc-12618652.description: The impact of progesterone receptor (PR) expression level on breast cancer prognosis in relation to menopausal status is unclear. This study evaluated the impact of the association between PR expression level and menopausal status on prognosis in patients with estrogen receptor (ER)-positive (> 10%)/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative breast cancer.

pmc-12718246.title: Polarised upgrading: the changing occupational structure of large cities in Germany and the UK, 1991–2021
pmc-12718246.creator: Daniel Oesch, Katy Morris, Gina-Julia Westenberger
pmc-12718246.description: An influential thesis predicted in the 1990s that large cities would become polarised as both high-wage professional and low-wage service jobs expanded at the expense of middle-wage workers. We revisit this thesis by analysing change in the occupational class structure of the ten largest cities in Germany and the UK, 1991–2021.

pmc-12837727.title: Comparative Molecular Docking, Molecular Dynamics and Adsorption–Release Analysis of Calcium Fructoborate and Alendronate Salts on Hydroxyapatite and Hydroxyapatite–Titanium Implants
pmc-12837727.creator: Diana-Maria Trasca, Ion Dorin Pluta, Carmen Sirbulet, Renata Maria Varut, Cristina Elena Singer, Denisa Preoteasa, George Alin Stoica
pmc-12837727.description: Background/Objectives: Hydroxyapatite (HAp)-based implants and HAp–titanium (HApTi) composites are widely used in orthopedic and dental applications, but their long-term success is limited by peri-implant bone loss. Local delivery of osteoactive molecules from implant surfaces may enhance osseointegration and reduce periprosthetic osteolysis.

pmc-12954828.title: Genetic Surveillance Reveals Differential Evolutionary Dynamic of Anopheles gambiae Under Contrasting Insecticidal Tools Used in Malaria Control
pmc-12954828.creator: Harun N Njoroge, Lilian Namuli, Sanjay C Nagi, Anastasia Hernandez‐Koutoucheva, Daniel P McDermott, Erin Knight, Samuel Gonahasa, Amy Lynd, Ambrose Oruni, Catherine Maiteki‐Sebuguzi, Jimmy Opigo, Adoke Yeka, Agaba Katureebe, Mary Kyohere, Moses R Kamya, Grant Dorsey, Janet Hemingway, Sarah G Staedke
pmc-12954828.description: Malaria, a febrile disease caused by the Plasmodium parasites and transmitted by mosquitoes, is a leading cause of mortality in children under 5 in endemic countries. The widespread deployment of insecticide‐treated bed nets (ITNs) has significantly reduced malaria transmission, but rising levels of insecticide resistance threaten to halt the progress.

pmc-13640304.description: ObjectiveHair plays multiple biological, psychosocial, and cultural roles, impacting psychological well-being and contributing to a rapidly expanding hair care market. This study aimed to validate a questionnaire assessing hair health and care (HHCQ) among young adults.ResultsA total of 200 participants completed the questionnaire (mean age = 20.75 years). Item screening and content validation reduced the initial 46 items to 32.
